personal_information.professional_title: Full Stack Developer · Python & Data Engineering · First Industry Role

professional_summary: Developer with strong technical foundations and real production projects, seeking my first professional role in the industry. My path into development came through technical teaching: 3 years training over 200 students in Python, Django, and JavaScript gave me a deep understanding of clean code, project architecture, and best practices. I built websites for real clients, data pipelines, and my own applications. Currently pursuing a Technical Degree in Programming at UTN, with over 800 hours of certified training in Python, AI, and Data Engineering.

projects.name: Music Intensity Analysis - Spotify
projects.description: Python data pipeline that processes and merges 7 CSV files with 1,199,120 songs: duplicate and out-of-range detection, cleaning, merging and a music intensity index (energy 60% + loudness 40%). Result: average intensity rose from 0.587 in the 1960s to 0.732 in the 2010s, and Rock is the most intense genre (0.830).
